noShortcutsRegisteredForContext: Kāore he pokatata kua rēhitatia mō tēnei horopaki.
aboutIntro: Ngā pokatata papapātuhi, ngā akoranga, te hapori me ētahi atu hei āwhina i a koe ki te ako me te whakatipu i a HAX.
haxDescription: He pūnaha tito taketake ki te tukutuku a HAX, i hoahoatia mō te whakaputa ihirangi wātea, whai wāhanga puta noa i ngā taiao tuku maha.
joinTheHaxDiscordCommunity: Uru mai ki te hapori Discord a HAX
issueQueue: Rārangi take (pepeke me ngā tono āhuatanga)
keyboardShortcutsDescription: Kua rēhitatia ā-pokapū ki HAXcms, ā, ka whakaaturia e te horopaki hohe. Ka whakamahi ngā here i te Ctrl+Shift+[Pātuhi]; i te ētita, mā te patopato i tētahi keu markdown kātahi ko te mokowā ka hurihia te poraka. Patohia te {slash} ki tētahi poraka kuputuhi kau hei whakatuwhera i te Rapu ā-rārangi.
tutorialsDescription: Tīmata ki ngā mahi ārahi, kātahi ka neke ki ngā akoranga hipanga-ā-hipanga.
apiLinksDescription: Ka taea e HAXcms te whakaputa whārangi i ngā hōputu e pai ana ki te mīhini kia taea ai e ngā utauta LLM te pānui me te tukatuka i ō ihirangi me te iti iho o te whakapai.
apiLinksFormats: Tāpirihia te {formats} ki ngā URL whārangi hei tono putanga whārangi kē.
apiLinksLlms: Whakamahia te {llms} hei taupū e anga ana ki te tauira mō tēnei pae, me ngā hono ki ngā rauemi matua ka taea e te mīhini te pānui.
apiLinksPair: Whakahonoa te {siteJson} (hanganga) ki te {searchIndex} (tiki) mō ngā tukanga mahi AI kaha ake.
apiLinksOpenapi: Tūhuratia te kirimana API pae i {openapi}.
